english: It was his job to repair bicycles and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
text: 这是交代他的工作职责，而不只是说他会修自行车。It was his job to repair bicycles 把修车定位为本职工作；若说 He could repair bicycles，讲的是技能，谈职业与谈能力时应选不同角度。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
